_meta.note: Random events are seeded per simulation run so runs are reproducible and shareable.

fields.probability: chance the event fires in a given run, before difficulty modifiers

events.name: Solar Flare
events.narrative: An X-class flare degrades the arrays for five days. Instruments draw more than the arrays produce.
events.mitigation_hint: A larger battery buys you through events like this. So does a power margin above 10%.

events.name: Detector Anomaly
events.narrative: A pixel row in the main detector is dead. Science quality drops permanently.
events.mitigation_hint: Redundancy costs mass; a second instrument can absorb the loss.

events.name: Ground Station Outage
events.narrative: A ground station antenna is offline for scheduled maintenance that was not scheduled.
events.mitigation_hint: Data backlog builds. Onboard storage and spare downlink capacity save you.

events.name: Launch Delay
events.narrative: A range conflict pushes launch by three months. Standing army of engineers still gets paid.
events.mitigation_hint: Budget reserve, or a launcher with a shorter lead time.

events.name: Debris Conjunction
events.narrative: A close approach forces avoidance manoeuvres. Propellant is a finite resource.
events.mitigation_hint: Higher orbits need fewer manoeuvres but cost more to reach.

events.name: Battery Degradation
events.narrative: Cell imbalance cuts usable capacity by a fifth. Eclipse operations are now marginal.
events.mitigation_hint: Sizing the battery for 35 min of eclipse with margin, not exactly 35 min.

events.name: Thermal Excursion
events.narrative: A radiator runs hot and the payload must be safed for two weeks.
events.mitigation_hint: Large buses have more thermal headroom than small ones.
